concept: Helping someone even when they can't do anything for you in return
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character helps someone who has no way to repay them, just because it's the kind thing to do
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did helping make the character feel, even without getting anything back?
exercise.practice: Student names one way they could help someone this week without expecting anything in return

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic act of help
